description: A feature conflict stops declaration evaluation before a later condition can raise a runtime error (engine §13).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%features g
%conditions $.classes = A
%features f
%conditions $.value.split($.tokens-after-first.value) = ∅
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text f? A
```
